in_marathi.name: Sharishma
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Peaceful, Shining, Radiant
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sharishma हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Sharishma is a Sanskrit name that means peaceful, shining, and radiant. It is derived from the Sanskrit words 'shanti' which means peace and 'rishmi' which means shining or radiant. This name is often given to a baby girl born during the night when the moon is shining brightly.
